pages: Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress with a white apron and bare legs, tips one barrow of broken limestone over the top rim of the kiln, hands on the handles. Middle distance: a heap of fist-sized stone, a long poker. Background: the brick kiln, open sky. Early morning light.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, lays one long iron poker into the arch of the kiln's base and pushes glowing wood deeper with it. Middle distance: burning logs, a shovel, a barrow of limestone. Background: the kiln's brick flank. Bright orange firelight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, holds one fist-sized lump of grey limestone up to the light, turning it in her fingers. Middle distance: a heap of broken stone, a sieve, a barrow. Background: the kiln mouth and chimney. Low morning light.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, draws one barrow of lime out of the kiln's eye, bracing the handles against her hips. Middle distance: a long iron hook, a shovel, banked ash. Background: the arch mouth, dark stone inside. Low firelight on her arms.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, kneels and lifts one hard grey lump of lime from the barrow, its skin flaking off. Middle distance: pale soft lime beside it, a shovel, a bucket. Background: the kiln wall, hard shadow. Cold morning light.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, waits beside one wooden bucket of water with grey lime sinking in it. Middle distance: a barrow of lime, a poker, a flat iron plate. Background: the kiln eye, banked fire. Grey morning light.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, crouches at the kiln eye and pokes one long iron poker into the fire under the arch. Middle distance: the draught hole choked with rubble, a shovel, a barrow. Background: brick wall, glowing stone. Orange firelight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, stands back from the kiln with one hard grey lump of dead lime in her open palm. Middle distance: pale lime in the barrow, a bucket, the arch. Background: the tall brick kiln against pale sky. Flat daylight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, counts the notches on one notched tally stick, holding it flat against her palm. Middle distance: a second tally stick, a chalk stub, a barrow. Background: the wall by the door, the kiln beyond. Dim lamplight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, sets one flat iron plate on edge across the front of the arch, packing mortar under it with her fingers. Middle distance: a barrow of rubble, a trowel, the warm bricks. Background: the banked kiln, night. Low firelight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, pushes one stone down into the kiln's eye with her heel, half a barrow of rubble beside her. Middle distance: a shovel, the iron plate, a bucket. Background: the arch mouth, dark night sky. Low firelight.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, watches one wooden bucket of water hiss and swell, pale lime heaped up over its side. Middle distance: the kiln, a barrow, a shovel. Background: the field, low sun. Bright morning light.

Nell, a girl of ten, dark hair in two braids, a coarse red wool dress and a white apron, writes one number on the tally board on the wall in chalk, brush in her hand. Middle distance: two tally sticks, an ink pot, a bench. Background: the open door, daylight from the yard. Cool morning light.
